boundary: A register of material contradictions and open evidence questions, not an Atlas: it records no dependency relationship and approves no claim. A resolution narrows a conclusion only where retrieved primary evidence justifies it; earlier releases are kept unchanged as historical records, and the public statements to revise are listed for editorial review.

state_definitions.open_conflict: Two or more sources state the same quantity or fact differently and nothing reviewed explains why
state_definitions.missing_primary_evidence: The quantity or fact is not stated in any reviewed primary source
state_definitions.version_scope_difference: Statements differ because they belong to different versions or editions; not a contradiction
state_definitions.source_access_blocked: The source needed to recheck the issue could not be retrieved
state_definitions.requires_reassessment: New evidence changes how existing statements should be presented, without resolving the issue
state_definitions.resolved_with_evidence: Retrieved primary evidence justifies a narrower, corrected conclusion; remaining uncertainty is stated

issues.title: MI300X Infinity Fabric: scope and direction of 896 GB/s
issues.question: Is AMD's 896 GB/s 'P2P ring peak aggregate' figure per GPU or per platform, and in which direction?

scope.temporal: AMD documents dated 2023-12-04 (platform data sheet) to 2026-09-28 (CDNA 4 paper edition)

evidence.locator: Data sheet: "direct connectivity of 128 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth between each GPU"
evidence.observation: AMD states a per-peer, bidirectional link figure.

evidence.locator: Data sheet: "seven AMD Infinity Fabric links for full connectivity between eight GPUs in a ring"; table: "7x 128 GB/s"
evidence.observation: AMD states seven scale-up links per GPU at 128 GB/s each.

evidence.locator: Product page: "Peak Infinity Fabric™ Link Bandwidth 128 GB/s"
evidence.observation: The product page gives the same per-link figure but lists 8 Infinity Fabric links.

evidence.locator: Platform data sheet: "a peak aggregate bidirectional Infinity Fabric bandwidth of 896 GB/s"
evidence.observation: AMD states the direction explicitly. The sentence says the platform connects all GPUs in the 8-node ring at this bandwidth.

evidence.locator: Platform data sheet table: "7x 128 GB/s per GPU"; "Ring of 8 aggregate bandwidth"
evidence.observation: AMD gives the per-GPU link set and labels the 896 GB/s figure as a ring-of-8 aggregate.

evidence.locator: CDNA 4 paper: "Each GPU offers >1TB/s of communication bandwidth within a node"
evidence.observation: For the later MI350 generation, AMD's '(8 GPUs)' P2P figure of 1,008 GB/s is described as per-GPU bandwidth; this is a labelling convention, not an MI300X statement.

issues.posture: AMD states that 896 GB/s is a bidirectional peak aggregate and that each MI300X has seven 128 GB/s bidirectional Infinity Fabric links to its peers. Seven times 128 GB/s is 896 GB/s, and AMD uses the same '(8 GPUs)' label for a later figure it describes as per-GPU, so the per-GPU reading is the better-supported one. No reviewed MI300X document states it, and the platform data sheet's wording reads as a ring-level figure, so the scope stays unresolved.
unknown: Whether 896 GB/s is per GPU or a ring-level figure
Link encoding and effective bandwidth
Whether the product page's eight Infinity Fabric links include the PCIe-capable host link
issues.next_evidence: An AMD statement of whether the MI300X 896 GB/s figure is per GPU, or the CDNA 4 paper edition containing endnote MI350-007

history.detail: Recorded as unresolved question u-i-amd-link-scope in Evidence Release 004.
MI300X data sheet and product page retrieved; both give 128 GB/s per link, the data sheet bidirectional.

Scope and direction resolved from AMD's data sheet: seven links at 128 GB/s bidirectional per GPU make 896 GB/s a per-GPU, both-direction aggregate. Release 004 is unchanged as a historical record; public statements are listed for revision.
MI300X platform data sheet retrieved: 896 GB/s is called a bidirectional peak aggregate and labelled ring of 8; seven 128 GB/s links per GPU.
CDNA 4 paper retrieved; the endnote MI350-007 cited in the PR #18 review is not in the edition published on 2026-11-11.

The IDE-008 resolution rested on arithmetic. AMD's documents state the direction but label 896 GB/s a ring-of-8 aggregate and never call it per-GPU, so the scope is not established. State set to requires_reassessment; public references corrected under rc-009-mi300x-infinity-fabric.
